description: The floating literal continuation indicator (ISO 6.2.3.1: a quotation symbol followed by a hyphen, ending a line inside an unterminated alphanumeric, boolean or national literal) - in either reference format; the continuation line begins with the opening quotation symbol and its content is appended to the latest logical line (6.5 4) and 8)). It is the only way to continue a literal in free form and the only way to continue a national literal in either format (6.3.5 2)), and the replacement the 2023 text recommends for the obsolete column-7 hyphen (Annex F.2 item 4). Recognized in ONE place, the 6.5 logical conversion's LogicalLineBuilder (kb/Work PB1359), which also enforces 6.2.3.2 SR4-SR6 (COBOL2684-2687, 2689, 2690). THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): COBOL-85 continues a literal only with the fixed indicator, §1985:IV.7.2.2 'A hyphen in the indicator area of a line indicates that the first nonblank character in area B of the current line is the successor of the last nonblank character of the preceding line', and 'If there is no hyphen in the indicator area of a line, it is assumed that the first nonblank character in the line is preceded by a space.'; §2002:6.1.2's table of floating indicators carries the literal continuation indicator, 'continuation of a literal when specified in an un-terminated literal with the same quotation symbol in its opening delimiter', §2002:6.2.4 continues a literal when 'A line terminates within an alphanumeric, boolean, or national literal that ends with a floating literal continuation indicator.' and 'National literals may be continued only with a floating literal continuation indicator.', and §2002:6.1.2.1 SR4 'A floating literal continuation indicator shall be specified only for an alphanumeric, boolean, or national literal.'; §2014:6.2.2 carries the same table. Gated in FIXED form only, once per compilation - the reference format a COBOL-85 source is written in; free form is itself a 2002 introduction (§2002:F.2 item 58) reached below 2002 only through the documented auto-detection extension (DOC-A.1-158), where this indicator is its only continuation.
